critical_code_review_comments: Live harness is intentionally isolated outside default tests/**/*.test.ts pattern.
Global fetch guard is fail-closed and restricts allowed endpoints/methods/origin with serialized dispatch and pre-dispatch ledger reservation.
No production module changes were made; supabase module is mocked only inside test runtime to avoid React Native import issues.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dry-run only completed. No real auth/probe/message/get_plan network executed. Harness is ready for controlled first live run after explicit authorization step.
rca_of_issue: Initial dry-run failed due Node/Vitest parsing of React Native import chain; fixed by adding local test-only mocks for ../../lib/supabase, @react-native-async-storage/async-storage, and expo-crypto to keep production modules untouched while still executing real transport/session wiring.
